researched_by: the council's own announcement plus local press
policy_summary:
Thrunscoe Land Motorhome Parking opened 31 March 2025 and remains the ONLY council car park in North East Lincolnshire where overnight motorhome stays are allowed. Ten hard-standing bays with three metres between vehicles, GBP12 for 24 hours or GBP24 for 48, two nights maximum.

Seasonal: closed from 1 November to mid-March. Payment is by the PayByPhone app only - the ticket machines will not take motorhome parking. There is an Elsan point for chemical waste and fresh water.

Reopened for 2026 with a new surface and prices held. Described by the council as popular since the trial began.
notes:
A proper conversion from trial to fixture, and the app-only payment is worth flagging to users: no signal, no payment, and unlike Fontburn there is no next-day arrangement.

The trial required a change to the Parking Order rather than a PSPO - the fourth authority confirming that pattern.
open_questions: Exact 2026 season dates. 1 November to 14 March is reported; the council quotes 31 March openings.
Is the 'no return within 7 days' rule current? It appears in a third-party listing, not the council's own text.

sites.name: Thrunscoe Land Motorhome Parking, Cleethorpes
sites.payment_notes: Ticket machines do NOT take motorhome parking. App only, paid on arrival - so no signal means no payment, with no deferral offered.

sites.notes: Southern part of Thrunscoe Land car park, on the hard standing near the Cleethorpes Coast Light Railway. GBP24 for the full 48 hours. Closed over winter, roughly 1 November to mid-March. Park centrally to keep three metres between vans.

sites.name: All other North East Lincolnshire council car parks
sites.notes: Overnight motorhome parking is prohibited in every other council car park. A height restrictor was installed at Marine Walk specifically to stop unauthorised use after joint enforcement with Humberside Police over the summers of 2021 and 2022.
